products.title: Paniermehl Cornflakes & Mandeln
products.description:
Glutenfreies Paniermehl auf Basis Mais mit Mandelsplitter.

**Dosierung:** nach Bedarf.

**Zutaten:** Cornflakes (Mais 96 %, Saccharose, Speisesalz); MANDELN 13 %.

**Allergene:** Nüsse

en.title: Breadcrumbs Cornflakes & Almonds
en.subtitle: Gluten-free decor breadcrumbs
en.description:
Gluten-free breadcrumbs based on maize with almond slivers.

**Dosage:** as required.

**Ingredients:** cornflakes (maize 96 %, sucrose, table salt); ALMONDS 13 %.

**Allergens:** Nuts

it.title: Pangrattato Cornflakes & Mandorle
it.subtitle: Pangrattato decorativo senza glutine
it.description:
Pangrattato senza glutine a base di mais con scaglie di mandorle.

**Dosaggio:** secondo necessità.

**Ingredienti:** cornflakes (mais 96 %, saccarosio, sale da cucina); MANDORLE 13 %.

**Allergeni:** Frutta a guscio

products.title: Paniermehl Quinoa (Paracas)
products.description:
Glutenfreies Paniermehl auf Basis Quinoa gepufft.

**Dosierung:** nach Bedarf.

**Zutaten:** Paniermehl (Reis, Mais, Speisesalz); Quinoa 20 %; Gewürze, Rapsöl.

en.title: Breadcrumbs Quinoa (Paracas)
en.subtitle: Gluten-free decor breadcrumbs
en.description:
Gluten-free breadcrumbs based on puffed quinoa.

**Dosage:** as required.

**Ingredients:** breadcrumbs (rice, maize, table salt); quinoa 20 %; spices, rapeseed oil.

it.title: Pangrattato Quinoa (Paracas)
it.subtitle: Pangrattato decorativo senza glutine
it.description:
Pangrattato senza glutine a base di quinoa soffiata.

**Dosaggio:** secondo necessità.

**Ingredienti:** pangrattato (riso, mais, sale da cucina); quinoa 20 %; spezie, olio di colza.

products.title: Paniermehl Tigernuts & Corn
products.description:
Glutenfreies Paniermehl auf Basis Erdmandeln und Mais.

**Dosierung:** nach Bedarf.

**Zutaten:** Tigernuss 50 %; Cornflakes 50 % (Mais 96 %, Speisesalz, Saccharose).

en.title: Breadcrumbs Tigernuts & Corn
en.subtitle: Gluten-free decor breadcrumbs
en.description:
Gluten-free breadcrumbs based on tiger nuts and maize.

**Dosage:** as required.

**Ingredients:** tiger nut 50 %; cornflakes 50 % (maize 96 %, table salt, sucrose).

it.title: Pangrattato Tigernuts & Corn
it.subtitle: Pangrattato decorativo senza glutine
it.description:
Pangrattato senza glutine a base di zigoli dolci e mais.

**Dosaggio:** secondo necessità.

**Ingredienti:** zigolo dolce 50 %; cornflakes 50 % (mais 96 %, sale da cucina, saccarosio).

products.title: Panademehl ohne Weizenmehl
products.subtitle: Glutenfreie Nasspanade
products.description:
Gewürztes, glutenfreies Panademehl.

**Dosierung:** 625 g/kg Wasser oder 1 kg für 1.6 kg Wasser; 10 min quellen lassen.

**Zutaten:** Kartoffelstärke; Speisesalz jodiert; Reisstärke; Gewürze; Dextrose; Verdickungsmittel: E 415, E 401; Gewürzextrakt.

**Allergene:** E 401, E 415

en.title: Wet breading without wheat flour
en.subtitle: Gluten-free wet breading
en.description:
Seasoned, gluten-free wet breading.

**Dosage:** 625 g/kg water or 1 kg for 1.6 kg water; leave to swell for 10 min.

**Ingredients:** potato starch; iodised table salt; rice starch; spices; dextrose; thickeners: E 415, E 401; spice extract.

**Allergens:** E 401, E 415

it.title: Panatura umida senza farina di frumento
it.subtitle: Panatura umida senza glutine
it.description:
Panatura umida speziata e senza glutine.

**Dosaggio:** 625 g/kg acqua oppure 1 kg per 1.6 kg acqua; lasciar gonfiare 10 min.

**Ingredienti:** amido di patata; sale da cucina iodato; amido di riso; spezie; destrosio; addensanti: E 415, E 401; estratto di spezie.

**Allergeni:** E 401, E 415
